top_signals.title: Hard to See What Can Stop Upward Trend in Yields, BNP Paribas Says
top_signals.summary: Isabelle Mateos y Lago, group chief economist at BNP Paribas, discusses concerns over ballooning US fiscal deficits and persistent inflation which sent long-dated yields to multi-decade highs last week. Speaking on Bloomberg Television, she also looks ahead to Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech on Friday. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Fidelity Fund Doubles Gold Holdings on Uncertainty Over Fed
top_signals.summary: A portfolio manager at Fidelity International Ltd. has doubled his fund’s gold holdings over the past three weeks, citing increasing uncertainty over US Federal Reserve policy as a catalyst.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Two US tanker aircraft leave Bulgaria a month after deployment upset Iran
top_signals.summary: Two U.S. tanker aircraft have left Bulgaria’s Bezmer air base, Bulgaria’s defense minister said, after their deployment in the Balkan country angered Iran.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Hedge Funds Ramp Up Dollar Shorts into Bessent’s Fiscal Plan
top_signals.summary: Hedge funds are ramping up bearish dollar bets as they await more details on Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s new fiscal plan to address the highest borrowing costs in years.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Fasset reaches unicorn status after $68 million raise led by SBI Group
top_signals.summary: Fasset raised $68 million in Series C funding at a $1 billion valuation, expanding its cross-border stablecoin infrastructure.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
